items.statement: Both named complexes require optimized S0 geometry and frequency/minimum validation before excited-state analysis.
Singlet and triplet calculations use distinct environmental boundaries.
IrF2ppz/H has an acetylide-localized dominant triplet transition.
items.expected: The H triplet assignment and localization are supported.

items.statement: IrF2ppz/CN has an acetylide-localized dominant triplet transition.
items.expected: The CN triplet assignment and localization are supported.

items.statement: The two complexes have distinct singlet excitation positions.
items.expected: Separate per-complex singlet energies are reported.
